gaps: P0–P2: none usable; P4: none; P6: no modern photo offered
notes: #1 is a colored bird’s-eye plan in a bound atlas that the Rijksmuseum dates 1600, but its style is that of a later Dutch atlas (Blaeu or Mortier, 1660s–1700s), so the date is doubtful; skipped. #2 is a flat fortification plan. #3 (Hessemer, 1827) is a true general view of the skyline but a very faint pencil drawing; it could replace #4 if a general view is preferred. #5 is the tram station, date range 1881–1933.
